images.alt: Four-panel diagram of Rule 110 cellular automaton: truth table showing eight 3-bit inputs mapped to output bits (left), coboundary operator δ on a three-cell neighborhood (top right), spacetime diagram from a glider seed showing emergent moving patterns (bottom left), and cocycle overlay where 24% of cells are marked as cocycle — the local rule fails to extend globally (bottom right). Cool blue spacetime with red cocycle highlights.
